import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import tarfile
import zipfile

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

files = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', 'src', 'tests', 'docs', 'noxfile.py', 'pyproject.toml', 'CHANGELOG.md']).decode().splitlines()
fingerprints = {name: sha((root/name).read_bytes()) for name in files}
groups = {}
for group, names in {
    'source': [f for f in files if f.startswith('src/')],
    'tests': [f for f in files if f.startswith('tests/')],
    'docs': [f for f in files if f.startswith('docs/')],
    'catalogs': [f for f in files if f.endswith(('.po', '.mo'))],
}.items():
    groups[group] = dict(files=len(names), sha256=sha('\n'.join(f'{name}\0{fingerprints[name]}' for name in sorted(names)).encode()))
result = dict(head=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip(), groups=groups, files=fingerprints, archives={})
dist = pathlib.Path('/tmp/cv-0636-review-dist')
wheel = next(dist.glob('*.whl'))
sdist = next(dist.glob('*.tar.gz'))
for path in (wheel, sdist):
    result['archives'][path.name] = dict(sha256=sha(path.read_bytes()), size=path.stat().st_size)
modules = ["crud_views/lib/views/manage.py", "crud_views_guardian/lib/views.py", 'crud_views/lib/manage_report.py', 'crud_views/management/commands/cv_manage_view.py']
catalogs = [f.removeprefix('src/') for f in files if f.endswith(('.po', '.mo'))]
with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as archive:
    names = set(archive.namelist())
    for name in [*modules, *catalogs]:
        assert sha(archive.read(name)) == fingerprints['src/'+name], name
    assert not any(name.startswith(('tests/', 'docs/')) for name in names)
    result['archives'][wheel.name]['verified'] = [*modules, *catalogs]
with tarfile.open(sdist) as archive:
    prefix = sdist.name.removesuffix('.tar.gz')+'/'
    names = set(archive.getnames())
    required = ['src/'+name for name in [*modules, *catalogs]] + ['tests/check_manage_schema.py', 'tests/test1/test_manage_command_ci.py', 'docs/reference/cv_manage_view.schema.json', 'docs/reference/manage.md', 'noxfile.py']
    for name in required:
        assert sha(archive.extractfile(prefix+name).read()) == fingerprints[name], name
    result['archives'][sdist.name]['verified'] = required
path = pathlib.Path('/tmp/cv-0636-review-refresh/fingerprints.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k != 'files'}, indent=2))

import datetime
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import time

name, command = sys.argv[1:]
directory = pathlib.Path('/tmp/cv-0636-review-refresh')
directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
before = time.monotonic()
log = directory / (name + '.log')
with log.open('w') as stream:
    result = subprocess.run(command, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash', stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
receipt = dict(name=name, command=command, started_at=started, duration_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-before, 3), exit_code=result.returncode, log=str(log))
(directory / (name + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt))
print('\n'.join(log.read_text().splitlines()[-12:]))
sys.exit(result.returncode)
